mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points within a month signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 25 basis points.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) and decreasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the previous month signals conflicting monetary signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increases and FEDFUNDS decreases simultaneously.
